model.unit: 1 bet = one max-bet hand; coins per max bet depend on the machine and denomination (GameDef.offers)
model.ruin: before a hand, bankroll < 1 bet (cannot cover a max bet)
model.mistakes: each hand independently, with probability errorRate, plays the next-best hold instead of the best
model.method: exact backward DP over integer bankrolls (src/lib/risk.ts); no simulation
model.excluded: comps, tier points, free play, promotions
